verdict.rationale: Orama is a search and RAG platform with AI features, so a data-training privacy posture is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no documented policy, opt-out, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI model training. On-prem deployment, self-hosted open-source use, and locally generated embeddings are related deployment and data-locality controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
